title_en: ‘No Escape’ for refugees on the frontlines of the climate crisis
title_zh: 身处气候危机前线的难民“无处可逃”

paragraphs.en: The climate emergency is an immediate crisis for refugees, with three in four – nearly 90 million people – living in countries facing high to severe exposure to hazards such as drought, floods and extreme heat.
paragraphs.zh: 气候紧急情况对难民来说是一场迫在眉睫的危机，四分之三的难民——近9000万人——生活在面临干旱、洪水和极端高温等严重灾害的国家。

paragraphs.en: Vulnerable as they are, climate financing is failing to reach many communities at risk, the UN refugee agency, UNHCR , warned in a report published on Friday ahead of the COP31 climate change conference opening next week in Antalya, Türkiye.
paragraphs.zh: 联合国难民事务高级专员公署（UNHCR）在周五发布的一份报告中警告称，尽管气候融资很脆弱，但仍未能触及许多面临风险的社区。联合国气候变化大会（COP31）将于下周在土耳其安塔利亚召开。

paragraphs.en: “Refugees face a double injustice. Forced to flee conflicts they did not cause, they are now on the frontlines of a climate crisis they have contributed least to,” said Antón Leis García, Assistant High Commissioner for Operations.
paragraphs.zh: “难民面临双重不公。他们被迫逃离并不是他们造成的冲突，现在却站在气候危机的前线，而他们对这场危机的贡献最小，”联合国难民署助理高级专员Antón Leis García说。

paragraphs.en: She fled El Fasher in wartorn Sudan’s Darfur region in June 2023 and now lives in a refugee settlement in eastern Chad where climate shocks are an ever-present risk, amid ongoing drought and persistent conflict.
paragraphs.zh: 她于2023年6月逃离饱受战争蹂躏的苏丹达尔富尔地区的法希尔，现在住在乍得东部的一个难民定居点，在持续的干旱和持续的冲突中，气候冲击是一个始终存在的风险。

paragraphs.en: Weather-related disasters triggered hundreds of millions of internal displacements worldwide over the past decade, while severe flooding linked to El Niño is expected to force three million people across Somalia, Kenya, South Sudan and Uganda to flee their homes by the end of the year.
paragraphs.zh: 在过去的十年中，与天气有关的灾害在全球范围内引发了数亿人流离失所，而与飓风Niño有关的严重洪水预计将迫使索马里、肯尼亚、南苏丹和乌干达的300万人在今年年底前逃离家园。

paragraphs.en: Climate change is also making it harder to find lasting solutions for displaced people. More than two-thirds of refugees who returned home in the first half of 2026 went back to countries that are highly vulnerable to climate hazards.
paragraphs.zh: 气候变化也使得为流离失所者找到持久解决方案变得更加困难。2026年上半年，超过三分之二的难民返回了极易受到气候灾害影响的国家。

paragraphs.en: In Syria, meanwhile, nearly four million people have recently returned to the country, where declining groundwater and severe climate shocks are threatening recovery after more than a decade of war. Flooding along the Euphrates River in May damaged homes, displacing thousands once again.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，在叙利亚，近400万人最近返回了该国，经过十多年的战争，地下水减少和严重的气候冲击威胁着该国的复苏。5月，幼发拉底河沿岸发生洪灾，房屋受损，数千人再次流离失所。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, nearly 90 per cent of stateless people worldwide live in countries that are highly exposed to climate hazards. When climate disasters strike, many struggle to access relief and support, because they lack legal recognition.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，全世界近90%的无国籍人生活在极易受到气候灾害影响的国家。当气候灾难发生时，许多人很难获得救济和支持，因为他们缺乏法律承认。

paragraphs.en: The report also shows how refugees and host communities are developing innovative ways to respond to climate change, including solar-powered water systems in the Sahel, climate-resilient agriculture in Uganda and land and mangrove restoration in Colombia.
paragraphs.zh: 该报告还展示了难民和收容社区如何开发应对气候变化的创新方法，包括萨赫勒地区的太阳能供水系统、乌干达的气候适应性农业以及哥伦比亚的土地和红树林恢复。
